where-nullable-null.sql:
SELECT [t0].[Id], [t0].[ParentId], [t0].[FullPath], [t0].[CreateDate]
FROM [dbo].[foc_Directory] AS [t0]
WHERE [t0].[ParentId] IS NULL

where-association.sql:
SELECT [t0].[FileId], [t0].[DirectoryId], [t0].[FullPath], [t0].[Contents]
FROM [dbo].[foc_File] AS [t0]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[foc_Directory] AS [t1] ON [t1].[Id] = [t0].[DirectoryId]
WHERE [t1].[Id] = @p0

first-or-default-shape.sql:
SELECT TOP (1) [t0].[Id], [t0].[ParentId], [t0].[FullPath], [t0].[CreateDate]
FROM [dbo].[foc_Directory] AS [t0]
WHERE [t0].[ParentId] IS NULL

orderby-date.sql:
SELECT [t0].[Id], [t0].[ParentId], [t0].[FullPath], [t0].[CreateDate]
FROM [dbo].[foc_Directory] AS [t0]
ORDER BY [t0].[CreateDate] DESC, [t0].[FullPath]
